description: Single-storey rear extension, raised patio with balustrade and steps to the rear. installation of a 1.0m high privacy screen at top of the raised patio; external alterations
decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s) shall be installed in the  side elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<p>Notwithstanding the drawings hereby approved, a 1.8m high obscure glazed balustrade/privacy screen shall be erected for the full length of the approved patio along the boundary with No.70 Lyon Meade.&nbsp; The 1.8m high balustrade shall be installed prior to use of the patio and shall be retained and maintained for the lifetime of the patio.&nbsp;</p>
